meta.name: emil-design-eng
meta.description: This skill encodes Emil Kowalski's philosophy on UI polish, component design, animation decisions, and the invisible details that make software feel great.

copy.tagline: 学习 UI 动效与细节打磨的设计哲学
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望提升软件界面的精致感和用户体验。
copy.tagline_en: Learn design philosophy for UI animation and polish
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to improve the polish and user experience of your software interfaces.

howto.what: Claude 会像一位注重细节的设计工程师，帮你审查 UI 代码、优化动画和交互，让界面用起来更顺手。
howto.when: 当你询问 UI 代码审查、动画设计或组件交互优化时触发。

say.text: 帮我审查这段按钮动画代码。
say.note: Claude 会以表格形式给出改进建议。

say.text: 这个下拉菜单的动画应该怎么调？
say.note: Claude 会分析动画目的、缓动和时长。

say.text: 如何让弹窗的出现更自然？

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a detail-oriented design engineer, helping you review UI code, optimize animations and interactions to make interfaces feel more polished.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for UI code review, animation design, or component interaction optimization.

say_en.note: Claude will provide improvements in a table.

say_en.text: How should I tune this dropdown animation?
say_en.note: Claude will analyze purpose, easing, and duration.

say_en.text: How to make the modal appear more natural?
say_en.note: Claude will suggest starting from scale(0.95) with opacity.
